task: explore: agent ergonomics of the tools MCP server (verified first-call examples)

errors.what: First fleet sweep ran a default-input probe that took DEFAULTS as every engine's input; 22 THROWs were all probe-shaped (DEFAULTS are options for array-taking analyze functions), not defects. A shell echo also split JSON on \n; replaced by a node script.

doc_friction.issue: Says to keep control-plane edits in their own small PR, but platform/agents/ (the agent tools server, a product surface rather than agent instructions) is in CODEOWNERS, so any feature work there is control-plane; easy to miss until after building.

deviations.why: Control-plane split: the post describes the platform/agents change, so splitting it into a separate PR would publish a post about unmerged code.
deviations.did: Kept code + post in one PR touching platform/agents/
deviations.result: Whole PR may wait on owner approval if the ruleset is applied

writeups: platform/agents/README.md (A first call that is known to work)
notes: Idea: make the repo's MCP tools server hand agents a verified first call. describe_tool now returns `example` found by running entry-shaped functions on what each module ships (DEFAULTS, sample*(), SAMPLE*, parse step then entry, or {} with a non-zero answer), rejecting NaN/ok:false/throws; run in a child with 8 s timeout. Coverage via platform/agents/example_coverage.mjs: 769 of 1,350 (57.0%); first version 355 (26.3%); accepting all-zero {} answers would have claimed 876. Also: miss errors list real exports; SITE follows build.mjs DEFAULT_BASE_URL (was redirect-only github.io). Verification: node --test platform/agents/*.test.mjs 22 pass; MCP handle() round trip describe->two-step example->call_tool. Next: add SAMPLE constants to the 581 tools without an example.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: design entry heuristics, fleet sweep, tests, post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
